title: Recipes: the newest first, and the filters as chips that open and close
boardTitle: DT347: the Recipes bar at rest, three chips; the sort as chips, Newest first

opportunity.from: Coach Milan 23 November 2026, 19:03, after making a recipe (Lazy Burek): sort newest first by default; the filter section is a big block, maybe chips or another way to show and hide it. 26 November 10:43: sort as chips too? Newest first and the default; how to solve the tension of so many chips at once.
opportunity.job: Find a recipe, often the one I just made.
opportunity.kind: Too much at once: twelve things to tap before the first recipe.
opportunity.why_now: The Recipes batch in Now (B164, DT347, DT346), with the design rules applied.

problem: At rest the Recipes bar shows twelve things to tap under the search: Made by ▾, Kitchen ▾, Moment ▾, Fits my day, No cooking, With my foods, then Sort with six words as text links. The bar is 250 px high, its chips 32 px. The sort is text, though picking one of six is an answer (a chip, D3), and its default is For your day, so the recipe I just made is not on top.
story: When I open Recipes, I want the list right under a short bar, with the newest first, so that I find the recipe I just made and open the filters only when I need them.
now: Under the search: Made by ▾, Kitchen ▾, Moment ▾, Fits my day, No cooking, With my foods; then Sort: For your day (underlined), Newest, Most made, Highest PD, Quickest, A to Z as text links. Kitchen opens its list under the chips.
proposed: At rest, under the search, three chips: Made by ▾, Filters ▾, Newest ▾ (the sort, showing its choice). Filters opens under the row: Kitchen ▾, Moment ▾, Fits my day, No cooking, With my foods (and Served, when there are plates to explore); with some set, the chip says Filters · 2 and is blue. The sort opens as chips, Newest first: Newest, For your day, Most made, Highest PD, Quickest, A to Z; a tap picks and closes it. Newest is the default. The bar's chips are 44 px (D10), round (D16), white until chosen and blue with a check when chosen (D6); a drop-down chip says its choice instead of a check. Three things to tap at rest instead of twelve; the bar is 155 px high instead of 250.
looked_at: Keep the sort as text, only Newest first: not chosen, picking one of six is an answer, a chip (D3). A filter icon instead of the word Filters: not chosen, an icon alone does not say what the tap does (D10). Hide the bar behind one button: not chosen, the search stays in sight.
short: Three chips at rest, Made by, Filters, Newest; the sort as chips, Newest the default; release 0.3.199

ac.title: Three chips at rest
ac.text: Given Recipes with 9 recipes, when I open it, then under the search there are three chips, Made by ▾, Filters ▾, Newest ▾, each 44 px high, and no Kitchen, Moment, Fits my day, No cooking, With my foods or Sort words on screen

ac.title: Newest first, by default
ac.text: Given my recipes saved on different days, when I open Recipes, then the newest is first, and the sort chip says Newest

ac.title: Filters opens and closes
ac.text: Given that, when I tap Filters, then Kitchen ▾, Moment ▾, Fits my day, No cooking and With my foods open under the row; a second tap closes them

ac.title: Filters says how many
ac.text: Given Fits my day and No cooking chosen, when Filters is closed, then its chip says Filters · 2 and is blue, and the line under says 6 of 9 recipes · Fits my day · No cooking with Clear all

ac.title: The sort as chips
ac.text: Given that, when I tap Newest ▾, then six chips open, Newest, For your day, Most made, Highest PD, Quickest, A to Z, Newest blue with a check; when I tap Highest PD, they close, the chip says Highest PD ▾ and the list follows

ac.title: Kitchen and Moment inside
ac.text: Given Filters open, when I tap Kitchen ▾ and Balkan, then Kitchen says Kitchen: Balkan, the list shows Balkan recipes and Filters stays open

ac.title: In every language
ac.text: Given Srpski or German, when I open Recipes, then the three chips, Filters · 2 and the sort chips are in that language

unchanged: The search and what it finds.
Made by ▾ and its list with counts.
What each filter and each sort does; the line under the bar with Clear all.
checks: Light plus the German sweep: the Recipes bar and its words. The unit tests (the sorts' order); the build; recipes-bar with new checks for AC1 to AC7 (it covers the bar, DT126c), and the walkthroughs that tap Kitchen, Moment, the three chips or a sort today change with the story, each with a note; design-rules, accessibility, deutsch, language. About 12 walkthroughs, 4 minutes. Words: recipebar.filtersN (Filters · {n}) and recipebar.sortIs (Sort: {sort}) are new (Srpski and German).
details: src/components/RecipeBar.tsx: Open gains filters and sort; Filters holds Kitchen, Moment and the chips, with their lists under it; the sort is a chip (rb-sort-chip) that opens six chips. src/recipeFilter.ts: SORTS starts with new. src/screens/RecipesScreen.tsx: the default sort is new. src/index.css: .rb-chips .choice 44 px; a chosen chip shows its check, a drop-down chip does not.
The pictures: before from main, 0.3.198; new from a scratch build of main with the change, not committed. Members' names are invented.
